=== logs-identity.yaml
# Written by `forge env up` from the env's forge.Telemetry declarations; included by
# deploy/observability/otel-collector.yaml. Regenerated on every run.
error_mode: ignore
log_statements:
- conditions:
  - attributes["service.name"] == "temporal"
  context: resource
  statements:
  - set(attributes["service.name"], "temporal")
- conditions:
  - attributes["service.name"] == "worker"
  context: resource
  statements:
  - set(attributes["service.name"], "billing-worker")
=== logs-parse.yaml
# Written by `forge env up` from the env's forge.Telemetry declarations; included by
# deploy/observability/otel-collector.yaml. Regenerated on every run.
error_mode: silent
log_statements:
- conditions:
  - resource.attributes["service.name"] == "temporal"
  statements:
  - set(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.original"], log.body) where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.original"]
    == nil
  - set(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"], ParseJSON(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.original"]))
    where IsMatch(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.original"], "^\\s*\\{")
  - set(log.severity_text, String(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]))
    where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"] != nil
  - set(log.severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_UNSPECIFIED) where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]
    != nil
  - set(log.severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_TRACE) where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]
    != nil and IsMatch(String(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]),
    "(?i)^(?:trace)$$")
  - set(log.severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_DEBUG) where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]
    != nil and IsMatch(String(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]),
    "(?i)^(?:debug)$$")
  - set(log.severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_INFO) where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]
    != nil and IsMatch(String(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]),
    "(?i)^(?:info|information)$$")
  - set(log.severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_WARN) where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]
    != nil and IsMatch(String(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]),
    "(?i)^(?:warn|warning)$$")
  - set(log.severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_ERROR) where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]
    != nil and IsMatch(String(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]),
    "(?i)^(?:error|err)$$")
  - set(log.severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_FATAL) where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]
    != nil and IsMatch(String(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["level"]),
    "(?i)^(?:fatal|critical|crit|panic)$$")
  - set(log.body, log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["msg"]) where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"]["msg"]
    != nil
  - delete_key(log.attributes, "level")
  - delete_key(log.attributes, "msg")
- conditions:
  - resource.attributes["service.name"] == "billing-worker"
  statements:
  - set(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.original"], log.body) where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.original"]
    == nil
  - set(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"], ParseKeyValue(log.attributes["forge.telemetry.original"]))
  - merge_maps(log.attributes, log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"], "upsert")
    where log.attributes["forge.telemetry.parsed"] != nil
- statements:
  - delete_key(log.attributes, "forge.telemetry.original")
  - delete_key(log.attributes, "forge.telemetry.parsed")
  - delete_key(log.attributes, "forge.telemetry.rule")
=== logs-preserve.yaml
# Written by `forge env up` from the env's forge.Telemetry declarations; included by
# deploy/observability/otel-collector.yaml. Regenerated on every run.
from: body
id: forge_telemetry_original
if: resource["service.name"] in ["temporal", "worker"]
to: attributes["forge.telemetry.original"]
type: copy
